name: Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple
town_description: Dharmapuri is a temple town in Jagtial district, Telangana, on the southern banks of the Godavari river - known as 'Dakshina Kasi' for its many temples. About 70 km from Karimnagar city (per travellerkaka.com), 42 km from Mancherial. Famous for astrologers, poets and Vedic learning.
